title: Moss Has Soft and Sharp
note: b415 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters ft, lt, lf.

pages.brief: Close view of Moss the hedgehog's soft brown tummy fur.
Close view of Moss the hedgehog's back, covered in short sharp pins.
Moss the hedgehog standing confidently among the grass, pins on full display.
Moss the hedgehog curled into a tight ball, a fox's shadow nearby.
Close view of Moss the hedgehog curled up, sharp pins pointing out in every direction.
A fox backing away from the curled, spiky shape of Moss.
Moss the hedgehog uncurled again, napping in a patch of sunshine.
Moss the hedgehog standing side-on, showing his soft front and sharp spiky back.
Moss the hedgehog trotting off happily through the grass.
